Bill.BriefDescription: Making ample provisions to support higher education.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to making ample provisions to support highereducation; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 82.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the tax imposed under this chapter, the first one cent ofthe state portion of the tax for each dollar on which the tax isapplied must be dedicated to and used for funding a public system ofhigher education within the state. (2) For the purposes of this section, "tax" means any tax imposedon the retail sale of personal property under this chapter.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the tax imposed under this chapter, the first one cent ofthe state portion of the tax for each dollar on which the tax isapplied must be dedicated to and used for funding a public system ofhigher education within the state. p. 1 SB 5693 (2) For the purposes of this section, "tax" means any tax imposedon the use of personal property under this chapter.
